theme.aesthetic: Cinematic Brutalism / Linear App Premium Style
theme.description: A movement/manifesto landing page. Pitch black backgrounds, high-contrast porcelain text, aggressive typography, deliberate spacing, and premium motion. No generic marketplace vibes. It feels like an exclusive, high-end operating system for opportunity.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Use a 4px base spacing scale. Strict adherence to optical alignment.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Wrap text lines in overflow-hidden spans, animate Y from 100% to 0%.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use scroll-linked parallax on the Hero video background (zoom out slightly as user scrolls down).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Elements fade in and translate Y upwards by 40px when entering viewport (easeOut, 0.6s duration).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements should have distinct micro-interactions (e.g., scale up by 1.02, border glow).
motion_and_interactions.spotlight_effect: Implement a mouse-following radial gradient spotlight on the Split Screen audience cards.

images.treatment: Real photography treated deliberately. Use grayscale or highly desaturated styling, aggressive clipped masks (sharp corners or specific polygon clips), and high-contrast ambient lighting to fit the dark cinematic theme. NO rounded corners > 8px.

components.header: Fixed top, z-50. bg-[#08090a]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10. NEVER fully transparent. Contains logo, minimal nav, and 'Start Earning' CTA in Neon Lime.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E4F222] text-[#08090a] font-medium px-8 py-4 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#D4E01B] transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#F7F8F8] border border-white/20 font-medium px-8 py-4 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider hover:border-[#E4F222] hover:text-[#E4F222] transition-colors rounded-none

components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for one slow editorial marquee in The Shift section. Serif or Mono font, text-8xl outline-only (text-transparent, stroke-white/20).

sections.name: 1. Cinematic Kinetic Hero
sections.background: Video background mapped to /webpage.mp4. Absolute inset-0, object-cover, with a bg-[#050505]/70 dark overlay.
sections.content: Centered. Headline: 'Stop Looking for Work. Start Creating Opportunity.' Subheadline: 'Your skills are worth more than you think. Turn your skills, knowledge, hobbies... into real income.'
sections.action: Primary CTA: 'Start Earning Today', Secondary CTA: 'Find Help Today'.
sections.motion: Video scales down from 1.2 to 1.0 on scroll. Masked line-by-line reveal for headline.

sections.name: 2. The Problem (Chapter 01)
sections.content: Brutalist Mono Chapter Label: '01 / THE BROKEN SYSTEM'. Massive minimal text block focusing on how people are treated as resumes, not creators.

sections.name: 3. The Shift (Chapter 02)
sections.layout: Relative container with overflowing marquee background.
sections.content: Text transitions from 'Who\'s hiring?' (strikethrough/faded) to 'What can I offer today?' (bright/neon). One extremely slow, massive editorial marquee behind the text reading 'OPPORTUNITY WORKSPACE'.

sections.name: 4. Split Screen Audience Cards
sections.layout: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-0 border-y border-white/10.
sections.content: Left Card: 'I Want To Earn' (Black bg). Right Card: 'I Need Help' (Deep Slate bg). Both contain hoverable lists of skills/needs. Use the provided artisan/workspace images as hover-reveals or clipped accents.
sections.motion: Implement a subtle Framer Motion mouse spotlight effect (radial-gradient following mouse cursor) on these cards.

sections.name: 5. Mission Manifesto
sections.layout: Stark, purely typographic section with numbered chapters.
sections.content: Focus on 'People already have value. They just don\'t have the infrastructure.' Minimal text, giant margins.

sections.name: 6. Transformation (Old Way vs New Way)
sections.layout: Visual 2-column comparison or a timeline flow.
sections.content: Old Way (Gig Marketplace/Job Board): Faded text, grayscale. New Way (Opportunity Workspace): Crisp, glowing white text with Neon Lime accents.

sections.name: 7. Closing
sections.content: Headline: 'Opportunity is already around you.' scales down from massive to readable size on scroll. Final CTA buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Ensure text over video has sufficient contrast via heavy dark overlays.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Lenis smooth scrolling in a top-level layout or App component.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for all structural and marketing layouts. DO NOT use rigid Shadcn containers (like Card) for these sections. Use raw divs, sections, and framer-motion.
Apply exact font stacks: Clash Display for Headings, JetBrains Mono for mono labels, Manrope for body text. Link these via Google Fonts or standard imports.

No generic rounded corners (e.g., rounded-xl) unless intentionally part of the 'Apple/Linear' glassmorphism pattern. Keep it sharp (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to maintain the brutalist/manifesto edge.
Follow the 4px Linear spacing pattern. Add excessive padding between sections (py-32 or py-40).
Never use pure black or pure white unless intentionally doing brutalist high-contrast. Base background is #08090a.
Implement the masked text reveal in the Hero using Framer Motion (overflow: hidden wrapper on lines, y: '100%' -> 0%).
Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the single editorial marquee. Keep it very slow.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and CTAs (e.g., data-testid='hero-start-earning-btn').
Create depth through 1px semi-transparent borders (border-white/10) rather than muddy box-shadows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px strokes.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds under headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
